mapper.select: SELECT t.task_id AS taskId , t.title AS title , t.description AS description , t.due_date AS dueDate , tg.genre_name AS genreName , ts.status_name AS statusName , t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tasks AS t INNER JOIN task_genres AS TG ON tg.task_genre_id = t.genre_id INNER JOIN task_status AS TS ON ts.task_status_id = t.status_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId}
